nom: The Ordinary Ascorbyl Glucoside Solution 12%, Vitamin C Serum

avis.texte: I really wanted to love this. I wanted to try a stronger vitamin C I tried this at least 12 different ways. Even when I'm having just having a sunscreen day it pills. I pills under makeup. I've tried applying it to damp skin, I've tried applying it to dryer skin and it still pills throughout the day. I give plenty of time to dry and never use too much product and it still seems to pill. I did love the way my face looked as soon as its on, it is very sticky, and it dries down okay. but man does it suck in about an hour if you put something it doesnt mesh well on top of it.

i absolutely love this product because it helped me out of months and months of what i thought was incurable dermatitis and then this came along and it's my absolute fav i've gone through at least 4 bottles now THANK YOU ORDINARY!💗

Goes on lightweight and smooth. Noticeable improvement in my dark spots and uneven tone since I've started using this product. Doesn't burn or irritate my skin like other Vitamin C solutions have in the past.
Works every time to clear out hyperpigmentation. I will keep buying this serum. Thanks ulta.

I use this product after my prescription acne product in the morning, and before my SPF. This serum has faded my once-prominent acne scars, and my skin tone is even. Powerful, but doesn't irritate my skin at all. I hope they never stop making it!

Definitely helps eliminate redness & evens my skin tone. I keep mine in the fridge, not sure if you're supposed to, but i think it being cold helps with my skin. I noticed a difference after 2 days. I apply it every morning & it lasts about 2 months for me

I've been using this serum for a few weeks, and it's fantastic! My skin looks brighter, more even-toned, and feels great. It absorbs quickly and layers well with other products. A great, affordable option for a vitamin C boost!

avis.titre: I know the ordinary works… just not on my skin
avis.texte: I mean it's affordable it's just too strong for my 54 year old Latino combination post menopause skin. I wish I could use this affordable reputable product however I am sticking with cosrx thanks to Laura sales associate at elmwood location in harahan Louisiana… she's awesome she tested recommended products on my skin… it sunscreen, Clinique moisturizer, Cosrx too.. very happy with level of customer service

avis.titre: Works wonders on VERY acne prone skin
avis.texte: I use this almost every night after experiencing a HORRIFIC month long breakout episode. I had very textured, discolored, acne prone (cystic & hormonal), oily skin and this product has helped with every issue. My acne scars have faded in the past 3 weeks of consistent use, and I havent had another breakout even during my cycle. This is an amazing gentle exfoliatiant if your skin isnt too sensitive or dry. I only use this once a day at nighttime combined with the Ordinary's skin barrier serum and salacylic acid serum for the daytime. Ive never found anything thats able to do what this product has done for my skin. With these 3 products, my skin has completely been renewed and I hope this never gets discontinued!
I bought the products a week ago and I'm reacting to the products I have emailed the company but they haven't responded as yet what to do. Thanks
Often i use this in the morning after washing my face amd before moisturizer, and i have found it pills off of my face

I've tried many different vitamin c serums and this is definitely one of my tops ones! I'd say it compares to the vichy vitamin c and this one is cheaper. definitely prefer this over la Roche posay's vitamin c.

avis.titre: Great product but wasteful size bottle
avis.texte: I love this product and can really see the difference it has made to my hyperpigmentation. However, I find it impossible to finish a bottle within the 6 months usage period, even though I use a generous amount twice a day, which seems terribly wasteful. Surely it would be better to produce a smaller sized bottle or increase the stability of the product so that it lasts longer than 6 months? Not a complaint, just a suggestion :-)
It's hard to find in stores so I constantly am praying that they keep making it.
Purchase 2 bottles. Open 1st bottle and the serum was a brown color with dark brown specks inside the bottle. Open the second bottle and it was the same. Is this the normal color?

I have been using Ascorbyl Glucoside for a couple of months on the back of my hands and it has really made a difference to the age spots I've had for years. They haven't gone but they are so much lighter. It does dry slightly shiny, but I then use moisturiser and it's fine. A brilliant product.

avis.titre: Be careful with this at night time!
avis.texte: The product itself seems to work well for my skin (Dry-sensitive), leaving it smooth and glassy, which a reduction in the appearance of sunspots. HOWEVER, be careful using this at night/bed time. It has left black bleach marks all over my white pillowcases and sheets from it rubbing off my face onto the fabric. I can confirm this also happened to another pair of sheets at a hotel I was staying at, where I was using the product.

avis.titre: Age spots on my hands are gone
avis.texte: I was starting to show light age spots on my hands and arms. After repeated use and less than two months the spots are gone. I use it right after I shower, let it dry and had moisturizer or you end up with a slightly sticky skin and then shiny/cakey. Highly recommend!

I've never written a review, yet here I am. This stuff has transformed my skin. I read that combining this form of vitamin C with Niacinamide does wonderful things. I have SUPER sensitive and acne prone skin (in my 60s!!). Within 3 days (no joke), my skin looked brighter and plumper. Since I started using this (over a month now), I have had zero (ZERO!) acne. I hope it continues and my skin won't "adjust" to its old, former self. WOW, just WOW. I find it feels oily even though it states it is water based, so I put the niacinamide on first, then this, then my spf moisturizer. Did I say WOW?!!!

avis.titre: Not for sensitive and dry skin
avis.texte: Not good for my skin as it triggered my dermatitis and also make my skin itchy and bumpy

avis.titre: Does what it says but not keen on texture after!
avis.texte: I am very low maintenance with my skincare but have benefited from a Vit C derivative, I do find I'm lovely and bright looking afterwards but I'm really not keen on the texture afterwards, it's quite tacky and taut, so great if you want that skin-tightening feel but it's not my favourite texture, I feel maybe a moisturiser like HA could be added in the formula... May start doing this myself tbh. But overall not a bad buy, just be aware if you have sensory icks & aversions.

I have been using this for a couple of weeks now and it has improved my complexion. It's just given me a little more glow, I can now tell my skin was just a little dull looking before. I will definitely keep using

avis.titre: good antioxidant if you use tretinoin
avis.texte: I use tretinoin for acne and anti-aging and if you're also using tret you're aware of how other skincare products don't always play nice with it. My experience with The Ordinary's Pycnogenol was a disaster and I wonder why I ever strayed from this. It's gentle on the skin, helps with sun damage and hyperpigmentation, and pairs well with Tretinoin. Unlike l-ascorbic acid serums its also very stable and DOESN'T SMELL. Every L-AA serum I've used smelled weird, like hot dog water (it isn't just the ferulic acid often incorporated into it). I just CANT deal with the hot dog water smell and this thankfully has no scent.

avis.titre: I keep coming back to this.
avis.texte: I have tried so many Vitamin C (LAA and Ascorbic Acid) but always stings and burn anything that is above 10% until the day i found The Ordinary Absorbyl Glucoside. At first application it does feel tacky but not when u wait few minutes for it to absorb, i have a very dry super sensitive skin from long term usage of tropical steroid cream and ended up with a very thin layer on my face at age 38. My face glows every morning since i use it day and night from using it for about a month. You may not like it because it's not LAA or AA but this serum did manage to keep my skin happy, glowy and non irritant. Would love to purchase it again once the bottle finish. Thank you for making me feel much more confident with myself.

This quickly became one of my holy grail skincare items! Within a few weeks of using I noticed my dark spots fading (and I had a good number of them due to acen) and my friends were commenting on how dewey and glowing my skin was looking. I apply every morning after a hyaluronic toner and right before my moisturizer. I have had no issues with lack of absorption or pilling. 10/10!

This one is by far my favorite Ordinary product. I'm in my 30s and have combination skin (mostly dull and dry, but sometimes oily) that likes to break out from pretty much anything. I use this product with the HA moisturizer and not only it does not break me out- any breakouts from other products somehow heal faster. And my face doesn't look like i'm stuck in a never-ending hangover when I wake up in the morning. I've tried Buffet and Copper Peptide serums before and Ascorbyl Glucoside wins.

avis.titre: New bottle = dry, tight and itchy
avis.texte: I've been using this for about a year and was pretty pleased with the results until I started a new bottle. I've spent the past year building up how often I apply it, from once a week all the way to 5 times a week and it's just not comfortable any more. I have extremely dry skin and ever since I started the new bottle a week ago my skin has felt dry, itchy and tight. Maybe the ingredients have changed? Or the manufacturing process? Whatever it is I'm hesitant to keep using it. I'm going back to once a week and will see what happens.

avis.titre: Good product - I am happy with the results. :)
avis.texte: I have tried this product off and on whilst looking for a regime for my sensitive / oily / acne / rosacea prone skin. I am a pale caucasian 28 year old female and this product does not irritate my skin and leaves my face glowing and looking hydrated. I use it at night under azelaic acid. I am yet to try it under my supergoop mineral spf and under makeup. I just wish there was more scientific evidence on the effects of anti aging (wrinkling and fine lines) Anyway, good luck out there everyone!! Xx

Texture is easy to spread. No scent, not sticky after feel. My moisturizer SPF lotions spreads smoothly. Just started using this specific product, will await to see any results. Have been using this brand (different products) for about 2 years.
I've used this product for months now, this will be my third bottle. I love it so much! Acne pigmentation disappears so quick and my skin feels amazing!

I've been using this product consistently for the past year and have really noticed a reduction in my skin's hyperpigmentation from acne scarring. I can't use traditional vitamin c products due to sensitivity and perioral dermatitis but this is the only product my skin absolutely loves! I think it works amazing as a vitamin c for those with sensitive skin.

I bought this product a few months ago after switching from the 100% L-Ascorbic Acid Powder. I switched to the Ascorbyl Glucoside Solution 12% as it is an indirect Vitamin C product which allowed me to combine it with a lot of other products. I have definitely noticed my skin becoming clearer in terms of texture and become more radiant, less dull. I will continue to use this product. If you have oily or normal skin, I would recommend this product. If you have dry skin like my fiance, I would recommend the Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate Solution 20% in Vitamin F. Please remember you can't use this with Niacinamide products.

The product gives an instant glow thanks to a layer of shine. I don't know how to describe it, so I put a picture of my hand, where you can see the edges of the product. The product ist completely dry on the picture! I really like the shine even though I feel like it gets lost after I apply my moisturizer. Anyhow the layer might feel odd to some. Personally I don't mind it and the feeling also goes away after applying moisturizer
I'm using this product for more than 6 months now, and all I can say is that it really works! It makes my skin look bright and plumpe, and the hyperpigmentation is gone!
The smell is really not mine..it smells allfull like old cleaning rags..but the skin looks hydrated and there is a good glow.

You know how you drink a LOT of water and it makes your skin look all luminescent? This had the exact same effect. My skin looked so healthy and bright! I swear my face looked like it was actually sparkling.

avis.titre: I would buy this again for sure
avis.texte: This product changed my life my face has 0 pimples or bumps and my skin tone is even and smooth

avis.titre: Its more oily feeling than i though it would be
avis.texte: I got this for free for my birthday from a store, ive been wanting a vitamin c serum for a while cause i heard and read good things about it for skin care. Ive been using it for less than a week and i love it, my skin looks great so far

avis.titre: Bad product from a great line
avis.texte: I wanted to like this so badly, but I should've listened to the reviews saying "you get what you pay for." The product does not go on smoothly, I personally didn't see any benefits after use, and it clumped upon application. I do LOVE The Ordinary, but this one just was not it. It didn't do any harm or aesthetic damage to my skin so I don't want to give it one star.

avis.titre: glucoside Solutionserum make my skin dry
avis.texte: after using 2 times my skin too dry and rough even skin pill off now what i do 1st time i order .... glucoside Solutionserum12%

I have been using it since months. AM PM. I keep my routine simple with a cleanser serum sunscreen n Moisturizer. I wanted to use only this one to see if it helps with the claims they make. Nothing. Literally no difference at all. I am highly disappointed :(
I had pretty low expectations but this gives such a great glow, I feel confident going without makeup

avis.titre: Best serum for fading acne scars
avis.texte: I have been using this product for almost 3 years now and it is very effective at fading my discoloration from acne and brightening my skin. I definitely recommend this product.

I've been trying different products from The Ordinary to brighten and even out my skin tone. I'm in my 50s with combination sensitive skin. This product caused a lot of redness and irritation on my upper cheeks. I didn't get to use more than two weeks. I tried to skip a day, and then use sparingly, but gave up as I was having to cover redness that I never had before, and it immediately went away when I stopped this. Disappointing and a waste of money. If you have sensitive skin be careful.

avis.titre: Great for post acne dark spots!!!
avis.texte: Works wonders! not sticky, absorbs quickly, does not irritate, does not stain clothing, 10/10 product! My skin is radiant! removed all my old acne dark spots
I had a bad reaction to the niacinimide zinc BUT this is saving my skin from the dark spots + scars! I use it before moisturizer and it doesn't feel sticky.
Definitely saw a difference in the brightening if my skin after consistent use. This is a budget friendly product as well.

I needed a new Vit C serum and thought I'd give this a try. So far (1 week) it hasn't caused any breakouts, and my skin looks and feels good when I apply this. I def see a freshness in my skin tone and my pores appear smaller. (it's also a rare cold front in FL- so that is a side affect of cool non-humid weather) Overall, I'm happy and would re-purchase this if I ran out next week!

I wasn't sure if I should give 5 or 4 stars because it took half of the product to see results, but be patient, you'll see results. I'm 32 years old and I suffer from rosacea. I don't usually write reviews because most of the products I've tried didn't give the results they promise, it was just mehhh. I used to go to bed having some expression lines, specially on my forehead, but since I'm using this product, I don't have ANY expression lines. I use a few drops in the morning and at night. It doesn't harm my skin affected by rosacea. Highly recommended for people in their 30s
This is serum goes on smoothly & absorbs quickly while brightening the complexion, neck & decollete.

after 1 week of use, I really love it, shows result after first application, and i started using only pm then come to know that can be used am and pm so using in am and pm both ordinary team please recommend which retinoid can I use with this at pm AS having a bunch of fine lines on forehead and which one layer first???

avis.titre: Gonna be a no for me...
avis.texte: Tried this and the HA moisturizer. Wow, my skin did NOT like this combo. I used for 1.5 months and my skin looks dry and dull. I drink 2.5 L of water a day, double cleanse, exfoliate, wear sunscreen. I threw out the remaining today and going to go back to my Biossance facial oil and Cetaphil!

So far I really like this product. I layer it on top of the ordinary's niacinamide serum after it has dried down. My skin looks nice and glowy after. I love it. I have not used long enough to say it has helped with aging, but it feels good so far.

Not all Vitamin C products work for me--this product makes my skin feel soft and moisturized while safely delivering the benefits of Vitamin C. It probably depends on your skin type because if you have oily skin this may not work. But for the many of us that are easily irritated by Vitamin C with sensitive or dry skin, it's worth a try. This is one of my favorites and I hope they keep it in store

I've gone through an entire bottle of this and will not be repurchasing. I was looking for something to help brighten and even out my skin tone. I've had good results with the Mario Tricoci vitamin C but wanted a less expensive option. This product, unfortunately, caused a lot of redness and irritation on my cheeks. I also noticed increased or worsening texture. I'm in my 40s with combo sensitive skin. I was really disappointed that this didn't work fo rme.
I have tried everything to get this product to work but it pills no matter what. I don't wear makeup but I still notice it when I apply sunscreen or wear a mask. Don't waste your money.

avis.titre: loving this addition to my skincare routine!!
avis.texte: i've been using this every morning after cleansing and i'm about to get my second bottle!! it's a great value for the price and i've definitely noticed a difference in my skin texture and acne scarring (smoother, lighter, etc.). it doesn't irritate my sensitive, acne prone skin, and i've even used it to lighten some stretch marks on my body! 10/10 would recommend

avis.titre: Great Product, Takes Awhile to Fully Dry
avis.texte: This product feels amazing going on, and I have noticed improvement in my skin with overall texture and appearance. My only critique is that it does remain sticky for about 10 minutes after going on, so applying anything over it in that time will result in pilling of makeup and things to that like. If you're strapped for time in the morning, I would recommend this as an addition to your nighttime routine.

I'm a licensed esthetician and vitamin C in the AM is one of my favorite things to do. Since I get antioxidants and anti-aging benefits. I use a base serum (one thats just hydrating) and use 2 drops of this and 1 drop of the ordinary pycnogenol 5% (also an antioxidant than can boost the effects of other antioxidants, such as the vitamin C and also offers anti-aging benefits). So these 2 together have made my skin INSANELY soft and smooth. Absolutely in love with the combination and will keep using.

I had such good results with the Vitamin C powder from The Ordinary that I didn't think anything could top it. After a year of constant use (along with daily use of the Mineral Factors and twice weekly application of the AHA peeling solution), my skin was so bright, so clear and any old hyperpigmentation either faded completely or just looks like a barely discernible freckle. I decided to try this however, because I wanted something I didn't need to mix with another product and...BOOM! I am blown away. After just 2 weeks of using every other day, my skin is even brighter, which I would not have thought possible. I am sold. I am hooked. (A little addition for my fellow brown and dark-skinned people: you know that hyperpigmentation is the bane of our existence. This may be a game changer for you if that's your main concern.)
Wanted to love it. Price is great, it does work to brighten and fade spots a bit, but it pulls under makeup. I tried everything to keep it from pilling, but it's a no go.

avis.titre: I LOVE THIS ON MY SKIN!
avis.texte: I bought this like a couple days ago, to test and try out. It worked perfectly. I recommend getting this ( for oily skin like mine)
This stuff in combo with a niacinamide serum has changed my skin. Reduced dark spots and just brightened my complexion! Skin looks much healthier.
I haven't used the product long enough to get results. But it does feel good going on.

I put this on mornings and nights and my face looks so much more healthier and glowy! It does dry down and isn't left feeling sticky at all or making my face look more oily. If anything, my skin looks less oily honestly. Absolutely love it :)

I'm a huge skin care fanatic,, I do my research and when I stumbled upon this product I had to try it! After using about half the bottle, I noticed no difference. I continued to finish the bottle so I wouldn't waste it and still no difference in my skin.

This serum is one that I keep coming back to, one of the only vitamin c serums that works without irritating my skin. I recently bought another bottle though and I immediately noticed a very strong chemical smell. It didn't use to smell like anything before, so I'm wondering if they've changed the formula or if I was accidentally sent an expired product? is it supposed to smell?
I use this on mornings when I don't use my Good Genes. It is a nice texture and feels good on my dry sensitive skin. Nothing earth shattering but a nice brightening serum
I have had dark acne marks on my cheeks and jawline. I wish I took before and after photos, but after 1 week of use, I can't believe the difference. This really works. Absolutely worth it!

I bought this product a few months ago and have been using it since then. I am very impressed by this product. It was suggested to me by the Deciem regime builder. It makes my skin look very bright and removes dullness. I pair it with Marine Hyaluronics every morning and they have been my go to products for having a clear, hydrated, bright skin. Would definitely recommend it.

I currently have my acne rosacea under control , but my skin is dull and dry. I live in a cold climate which makes matters worse. Anyway, I used this product for the first time last night. In the morning, when I went to wash my face and put my foundation on, something was happening. I began to see dead skin starting to roll off onto my hands. It is not pilling. The product was no longer on my skin. It was a sign that it is working! I continued to rub off the dead skin and reapply my moisturizer and foundation. My skin feels softer and looks a tad smoother. I plan to start carefully and use only a few times a week at first in hopes of not angering my rosacea. My skin still seems calm. I hope to update with glowing results!

I have suffered from cystic acne since I was about 13 (I'm 27 now and still struggling…) but I swear that this has saved my skin. I have combination, sensitive skin and I almost exclusively break out on my chin. I had found a routine that was working ok but I'm also a healthcare worker so I spend all day in a mask, which has been incredibly detrimental to my progress on my skin. I started using this almost 3 months ago and at first I had some purging, but over the last month my skin has seriously transformed. I've hardly had any cystic breakouts even when I'm sweating under an N95 all day 😅 my scars and hyperpigmentation have faded and my skin is glowing. I use this every other day cause I don't wanna overdo it, but I can't recommend this product enough. Try it if my skin type resonates with you, especially at such a great price!

This product does wonders for the skin. I've been pairing this with a Niacinamide serum for the last year and a half and have seen wonderful changes in my face. The main thing i've noticed is that a lot of the hyperpigmentation and scars that I had in the past have faded and are barely noticeable now. I also have very sensitive skin and am prone to breakouts, but this solution is very gentle and paired with the niacinamide, has actually helped reduce my acne in general. One thing to note, as with any skincare product, it takes TIME for things to start working and for your skin to start changing on the surface. I truly believe this is a phenomenal product for the price and will continue to use and recommend!

Realmente me encantan casi todos sus productos!! Este producto en particular me ha encantado con mis rutinas, tengo mi piel muy linda y las manchas en mi cara han disminuido mucho!!!! Lo único que no me ha gustado es la demora en la entrega de los productos!

I really wanted to love it like all the ordinary products but this one burned my face pretty bad and left a red reash after. I am a huge fan of the retinol and the moisturizer but I guess my skin just didn't agree with this one.

I started using this after a bad reaction to the Ascorbic Acid 8% + Alpha Arbutin 2% product. I've used it for 7 months now, but haven't noticed a difference at all, sadly. I.e. no difference to hyperpigmentation and no visible skin brightening effects. My skin tone is tanned/south asian.
This was the first The Ordinary product I used and I love it. It makes my skin look healthy and glowing

I am very impressed! Due to inflammatory reactions on my skin and also enjoying to much sun this last summer I had developed dark spots all of a sudden, that sadly would't go away. And they aged my face with 5 years. I have been using it for two full weeks and I only use it in the morning with a spf on top of it, my skin looks a lot beter. The spots are still there but they have faded a lot. And they still are. Even my skin tone is a lot more even, which I was not full aware of that I didn't have it anymore. So happy with my skin right now, it is looking beter and clearer by they day and my dark spots are fading away. Sound like an rime and it is but I am really happy with this! Thank you for this amazing product!

This vitamin C serum is amazing! It definitely smoothes and brightens my skin. It gives a little lift and feels smooth and cool on the face. Definitely would buy again! Has no fragrance. Easy to apply. Only need 2-3 drops to cover your whole face. Would recommend. Great for daytime skincare routine.

avis.titre: Irritated my skin, not for me.
avis.texte: I recently purchased this vitamin c to replace the one from Olehenrisken which I LOVE but it's a little pricier. I love trying new skin care & I've never had a bad reaction to products and this one had for the most part great reviews & I liked the consistency & smell wasn't bad. Unfortunately my cheeks got super irritated and red and felt rough. I figured it was this BC both days I put it on it happened & it was the only product I had changed in my skin care. Will most definitely go back to my Olehenrisken Banana Bright Vitamin C Serum. PS I have Normal to Dry skin if it helps ( normally not sensitive at all )
Only vitamin c that hasn't made me breakout in my hormonal chin and jawline area. Two weeks and it has given me need hydration for the colder months and helping with my dark spots

Have been using 1-2x a day consistently for around 4 months now. Had pretty bad hyperpigmentation scarring from acne that is honestly nearly gone now. Tried a few other products before this but would recommend this over any of them! Also has no bad texture or smell so is perfect if you hate that sort of thing!

avis.titre: Good but be careful with dry skin!
avis.texte: I actually like this product I've had it for about a week and I've already gotten compliments on brightness..however it makes my skin feel super dry and tight. I only use it with pycnogenol and NMF and when I stopped using it for a day the dryness was no longer there. I'm not sure what to replace it with, maybe a suspension? For now i might just use it on my chest for now.

avis.titre: I just re bought this item !!
avis.texte: This is seriously the best product! both the price and quality is amazing! It brightens your face, lightens dark sports, and leaves your skin GLOWING

I've been using this vitamin C serum for about 4 years now, and love the results. It goes on so smoothly and just sinks right in. I also put it on my hands and neck. Combined with using one of the Ordinary's retinol serums as well, I've seen such a difference in my skin over the past years - old scars and pigmentation are gone and I feel like I have really nice skin now. It took at least a year for me to really see results, so be patient!

I have generally had excellent luck with The Ordinary's active products (lactic acid 10% and granactive retinoid 2%) and this is no exception. I have skin that borders on sensitive and doesn't always play will with pure l-ascorbic acid serums. I have previously used other Vitamin C derivatives such as sodium ascorbyl phosphate, with okay results, but with this I have finally found my perfect Vitamin C serum. It has evened out my skin tone and really helped with fading dark spots from maskne. The glow is also amazing and I love layering this under my sunscreen to give it a boost. It also feels cosmetically elegant and non-sticky. Absolutely loving it and will definitely repurchase!

I've spent so much money on products to help fade my hyperpigmentation but none of which worked for me. But surprisingly after using this product I noticed results after just 2 days. My skin overall looked much brighter and healthier. I also noticed some of my dark spots completely faded after just a week. I use this serum along with The Ordinary's Alpha Arbutin 2% + HA. I believe using these two in combination helped gain faster results. I've been using these two products both in AM and PM for about 2-3 months now and this is the clearest my skin has ever been ! Will definitely be reordering

avis.titre: I feel like I'm pampering my face
avis.texte: After I wash my face and put rose water i lather my face with vitamin C

avis.titre: A vitamin C that finally worked for my skin!
avis.texte: I've tried both Vitamin C suspensions in the tubes from this brand and neither really worked for me, but I saw this one and decided to give it a try even though I'm pretty unfamiliar with it. It works SO WELL! I used to have a somewhat dark PIH mark on my chin from a regularly appearing cystic acne spot, but this serum has faded it to practically nothing! The few light scar marks I've had on my cheeks from a terrible bout of acne a few years ago have all but disappeared and my skin looks brighter and more even. The texture is nice and absorbs well on my skin, it layers well with my moisturizer, and I've had no stinging or reaction to it.

I've been through a few different vitamin c's from the Ordinary - I loved the silicone suspension, but I found that I felt I had to use more product than I wanted to. I switched to the EAA 15%, but it was just so oily even if I let it dry, waited, moisturized, etc, that I couldn't do it. This stuff has a much better feeling on the skin - lighter, slightly tacky but nothing to be concerned about. Highly recommend if you're not a fan of other formulations from the brand - this is the lightest one I've tried.

I've had issues with acne, oil in my t-zone, and hyperpigmentation for years. Once I started using this product, my skin has cleared up, my oil is controlled, and my dark spots have noticeably faded. I use this at night with Alpha Arbutin and Azelaic Acid. A little goes a long way - a couple of drops works wonders. I'm very happy with this product line.
I purchased 2 bottles last year and have been using regularly for over 6 months and it has done absolutely nothing!

I've been using this for 6 months at night, before moisturiser and my skin is noticeably smoother and brighter. I have had multiple comments saying how glowy my skin looks! The texture is fine, no irritation at all!

avis.titre: Sticky liquid, Clogs Pores, doesn't brighten
avis.texte: I've purchased two of these because M.A.P - Magnesium Asorbyl Phosphate has been out of stock for over a year. Unfortunately it causes of lots of tiny non-inflamed pimples for me in areas I would not normally get them. I thought that it might just be purging initially, but now I am part way through the 2nd bottle and within hours of wearing this I get little pimples. This product isn't good, even the smallest amount alters the overall "finish" of my skin and it isn't helping with pigmentation from spots at all. I really miss M.A.P

The serum is a little bit sticky, absorbs veeeery guickly - it can be problematic in aplication somethimes but I learned how to work with it. I think it helped my with post inflammatory pigmentation (but not with dark circles under eyes) and with wrinkles.

I've been using this product every AM and I absolutely love the way it dissolves onto my sensitive skin. I can put it under sunscreen & make up without feeling oily. I have also noticed some improvement in my dark spots. I will continue with this product.

I've been using this product for about 6 weeks now. I wasn't big on my skincare routine before, just a cleanser and moisturiser. Now I have a full routine in place with The Ordinary and I wouldn't go back. I've seen a huge difference in my skin and other people have commented too. This has made my skin so much brighter and has really evened out my tone. Between this and the other products in my regime, my complexion is clear, my skin is brighter and it feels fully moisturised. I haven't worn a bit of make up in 4 weeks and I previously never left the house without it.

avis.titre: Very light weight and didn't irritate my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I use it morning and night. It was my first time trying so I'm not sure if it's helping for my discoloration just yet but it feels great on my skin.

I have been using this product for at least 2 years now. I have drier skin and have no irritation while using this product. However I do experience brightness, an overall glow and my skin just looks prettier/plumper literally the next day. Great product.
Tried this on a whim because I couldn't find my other one at my local Ulta and am absolutely in love! Helped my under-eye spots and redness so much! I am never going back.

I wanted to add radiance to my skin and improve the evenness of my skin tone. I chose this after reading reviews and guidance as I hadn't used a Vitamin C serum before and didn't like the grainy, coated feeling that some other products in the range leave behind. After a few months of using this unfortunately I haven't noticed any effect at all, so won't be buying another. I'm a happy repeat buyer of other products from The Ordinary so just think this one may be too gentle for me. Maybe it's better for people with sensitive skin.

This stuff is incredible. Been using it for a few months and I've seen a big difference. I've always had dark circles and they are actually lightening for the first time in my life. It's wild. And I know vitamin C doesn't claim to reduce blackheads but after I started using this serum, my blackheads have looked better than ever before. Most of them are gone and the ones that are visible are so much lighter. It's amazing. And my skin just feels soft and brand new. It's the best product in my whole skincare regimen.
This product is meant to be used first before you use any other face products. Let it be absorbed before any other serums or cream.

avis.titre: This is a good vitamin c serum
avis.texte: I tried the naturium vitamin c serum before this and it felt like putting honey on my face, then when I put on my sunscreen it all just pulled off. This serum doesn't do that, it feels a bit sticky after I put it on, but once I put on my moisturizer it just sinks in, I am a big fan of this serum!

At first I never used Vitamin C in my skincare routine but after 1 week of using this my pimples and redness went away. It might not work for all skin types but my type is combination skin and it worked great!

I bought this couple months ago and can tell that it is definitely working! My skin does look brighter and it calms my pigmentation. I use it both morning and night. Half the bottle is gone already. I will be stocking up again. The only complaint however, is that I've noticed if my face gets wet, the product seems to foam a bit so that is annoying, other than that I am pleased.
Made my skin bumpy and had a bad odor. Might've gotten a bad batch, but this made my skin break out.

This product is one of my favorites. I have been using it for about a month every morning and evening and I have definitely noticed my skin is brighter and has much more of a glow. I have acne prone skin and it's normal-oily and I haven't had a single problem with it. wonderful product- 10/10 would recommend!!!

I wanted to like it so badly! I always try the Ordinary products because they are so affordable but I end up not liking them because of scent or consistency. I've been using this serum only for a few weeks and haven't noticed any difference in dark spots. I would keep trying it but I HATE how oily it is. It's so thin and greasy I feel so gross when I put it on my face and it takes like 10 minutes to dry and "absorb". I tried to use it 2x a day but I don't have that much time in the morning to wait. It's a shame because other vitamin C serums cost at least twice as much as this. Maybe this will benefit people with dry skin because I have oily skin and it doesn't absorb well and sits on the skin.

After dermarolling my acne scars I use this serum and for everday use for about a month now and I have gotten my results on evening my skin tone I believe in another month ill be getting even more amazing skin Im extremely happy with this product . . . Also I have sensitive skin and It did not effect me ✨

avis.titre: Would be good for non-sensitive skin.
avis.texte: I've been using this for a couple of months now, and I think it may have irritated my skin a bit and caused some bumps on my cheeks. I don't use any conflicting products like AHA/BHA or Niacinamide with this, so I know it is not for that reason. This is a great vitamin C product and doesn't sting or feel greasy - it's just not for my skin type!

I bought this product because I have hyperpigmentation and sadly this product did nothing for my skin. U used it only at PM as it has vitamin C. Plus, the texture is pretty sticky and sat on my pillows. Quit disappointed.

avis.titre: I wouldn't buy this product again
avis.texte: I heard good things about these products but it honestly did nothing for me
I've been using this serum for about a week and can see the difference in my skin already. I have oily skin and this has helped a lot, now my skin is smooth and more even looking.
First time using vitamin c and it is sooo good! I've noticed such a difference with my skin!!

avis.titre: Seen improvement in old pimple spots/pigmentation
avis.texte: I been using the mandelic acid and rose hip oil in my nighttime routine and seen great improvement in my acne/overall skin health. I have been trying out other ordinary products and decided after research that the Ascorbyl Glucoside Solution 12% was the best Vitamin C option for me. I now do the squalene cleanser, Mandelic acid, wait for it to soak in then apply the AGSolution 12% before the rosehip oil or squalene (I alternate depending on time of month) I have seen a visible improvement since adding the AGSolution 12% in reduction of past acne spots and will continue to use.
So far so good. I have sensitive skin and I have had no breakouts.

The vitamin C serum from Ordinary is my daily skin care routine. I have a combination skin and recently due to wearing mask most of the time due to COVID, my skin started having break outs and had to deal with acne. I stopped using it for a while because I thought less skin care product would make my acne go away and actually it made it worse. I started back to my routine of cleansing (cetaphil), toner, and THIS VITAMIN C and cerave moisturizer two times a day and made my skin much better in a week or two. I really could see the difference and my acne has gone and it is also helping me with acne marks. Bottom line, its amazing and has worked on my skin.

avis.titre: On my way to buy my second bottle
avis.texte: I only use this product at night. I put it on after cleansing, and after using the ordinary Niacinamide serum. I've been layering the two for about 8 months and it's been working for me. I've noticed that my skin is more radiant.

Great product for making skin luminous and reducing scars and blemishes. It looks noticeably brighter. Is ETHYLATED ASCORBIC ACID 15% SOLUTION a better Vit c serum than this?Thx DECIEM Response: Thanks so much for your review! We wouldn't say one Vitamin C serum is better than another :-)
